text: Meeting deadlines can be stressful, but good planning makes it easier. Start by breaking your project into smaller tasks and estimating how long each will take. This is time management. Next, practice prioritization: decide which tasks are most important and do those first. Be honest about your scope management—if a project is too big, discuss reducing some parts with your team or client. Finally, don't forget communication. If you see a problem early, tell others. They can help adjust expectations or provide support. By staying organized and talking openly, you can meet your deadlines without unnecessary panic and keep your stress levels low.
